pure-announcement.rationale: It is product integration documentation for Dependency-Track, not a launch, release note or funding announcement, despite the preview-feature banner.

duplicate.rationale: The only durable idea in the note — that OSV aggregates vulnerability databases in the OpenSSF format and pins affected versions — is already substantively covered by the osv-format concept, which even names Dependency-Track as a consumer; everything else here is DT-specific configuration, so a reader of osv-format learns no new concept.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The integration behaviour is documented and checkable against the OSV bucket and Dependency-Track itself.

durability.rationale: It is single-product integration documentation pinned to versions (v4.8.0), a preview-feature warning, and a mutable ecosystem list — none of which survives twelve months, while the durable OSV idea lives elsewhere.

actionability.rationale: Its actionable content is product-only configuration steps — select ecosystems to mirror, leave alias sync disabled in Dependency-Track — the canonical shape of weak actionability.

atomicity.rationale: It stays on one subject, Dependency-Track's OSV integration, statable in a single paragraph rather than bundling separable ideas.
